svg.title: Pleural effusion constellation — reading-order relationship ledger
svg.desc: A strong top-down taxonomy followed by bindings and anatomy, then one row per causal, progression, co-occurrence, and manifestation relationship. Every row keeps its relationship properties attached.
svg.text: Read downward: what it is → what it binds → what causes it → what it does and looks like.

g.text: Descent means “more specific.” Thick unarrowed branches are SUBTYPE_OF, not ordinary relationships.
Direct HAS_ELEMENT bindings on pleural effusion; only presence is required.
Explicit, not inherited: all six diagnosis subtypes each have their own required HAS_ELEMENT → presence edge.
Internal complexity values: septations · loculation · gas · dependent debris · fluid-fluid level
One edge per row. Arrow direction is source → target; every typicality and expected hint stays inside its row.

text.tspan: · expected: bilateral, right > left; simple fluid
· expected: right pleural space in most cases

g.text: 4 · What follows, accompanies, or provides evidence
Distinct line grammar remains visible in grayscale: solid causal, purple evidential, teal progression, dashed symmetric association.
Node IDs are shown in the taxonomy; relationship IDs are retained as data-edge attributes and printed where space permits. Source: core.jsonl + pleural-effusion.jsonl.
